newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Motor March vehicle sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Motor March vehicle sales fall.

text.p: Hyundai Motor Co Ltd, South Korea's largest car maker, said on Wednesday its vehicle sales in March fell 7.6 percent to 101,957 units from 110,329 units a year earlier.
Hyundai Motor, an affiliate of the Hyundai Group, said exports rose 2.7 percent to 51,575 units in March from 50,228 units in the same month last year.
Domestic sales dropped 16.2 percent to 50,382 units from 60,101 units.
A Hyundai spokesman said the fall in local sales was due to a slowing economy and introduction of new models by Daewoo Motor Co Ltd, a unit of Daewoo Group.
Daewoo began selling Lanos compact cars from November last year and larger-sized Nubira cars from February.
Hyundai's Accent and Avante models compete with those Daewoo cars.
